To resolve this issue, the following files must be inspected (which were not provided in the selection):
1. `vispy/gloo/gl/_constants.py`: This is the most likely location where encoding errors or incorrect character mappings exist.
2. Any other files within `vispy/gloo/gl/` that define constants or mappings.
